reserveReview.rationale: The authored composition remains the historical June 30, 2026 snapshot reviewed on 2026-08-08. Re-check 2026-10-01: the issuer publishes a 30 August 2026 USDQ snapshot with 33% cash, 66% government bonds and a 101.91% reserve ratio. The published categories total 99%; no undisclosed remainder is inferred or normalized. The dollar reserve policy names US Treasuries. These newer disclosures do not refresh the historical weights or their composition date.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Quantoz Reserve Status Overview updated June 30, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The two disclosed categories cover the full reserve allocation, but Quantoz does not identify individual banking partners, bond security identifiers, country weights, or a maximum maturity. Liquidity horizon therefore remains unknown for the government-bond bucket.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Stichting is the disclosed safeguarding foundation, not a named deposit bank or securities custodian. Individual banking/custodian identities, allocations, anti-rehypothecation and successor-custody mechanics remain undisclosed.
